title: Netskope + Entra ID SSO & Identity-Based Policy Enforcement
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (IdP integration: SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning + identity-steered policy between Netskope and Entra ID).
Distinct from conditional-access-integration (Entra CA): this product integrates Netskope with Entra ID as IdP and enforces identity-based SSE policy.
Netskope console internals are deferred to Netskope's official documentation (no fabricated menus); authored at the correct architectural/procedural level.
